spine: 1. 傳統共識演算法（Raft、Multi-Paxos、VR）把進度綁在單一 leader 的可用性與可預測延遲上，leader 慢或斷線，整個系統慢或不可用。
2. 這不是假設：2020 年核心交換器局部故障讓依賴共識的 dashboard 慢 80 倍、六小時，且寫入不可用。
3. 三種卡法：Paxos 的 destructive interference、Raft 的分票與自我強化的選舉失敗、fault detection 的超時隨網路延遲放大。
4. QuePaxa 的結構：proposer 與 recorder 兩種角色，leader 可有可無且擁有固定最高優先權，其他 proposer 抽隨機優先權並採用更高者，所以無法無限期互鎖。
5. 安全來自多數交集，一輪四個階段（Propose and Adopt、Spread、Check and Decide、Carry Forward）；leader 是唯一能單一 round trip 決定的角色，client hedge 給每個 replica。
6. hedging 超時由 replica 本地決定、不是 fault detection，所以不受網路延遲限制；Raft 常見 election timeout 為 RTT 的五到十倍。
7. 代價：QuePaxa 沒有 Raft 或 Paxos 那麼廣泛的實戰檢驗，Cloudflare 以形式化驗證與擴充 crash recovery 補強；測試中超過 95% 決定由 leader 於第一階段完成，leader 失效時變慢但不停。

perspective.mechanism: QuePaxa 以 proposer/recorder 角色、隨機優先權、多數交集與四階段一輪，讓進度不依賴單一 leader；leader 只提供單一 round trip 的快路。
perspective.tradeoff: 換取對 leader 失效與網路波動的耐受力，代價是協定較新、實戰驗證不如 Raft 與 Paxos，需要自行做形式化驗證並擴充 crash recovery。
perspective.reader_use: 台灣工程師評估共識元件時，可用文中的問題檢查系統進度是否綁在特定節點延遲上、失效偵測超時是否受 RTT 支配，以及自己能否補足新協定缺乏的驗證。

perspective.mechanism: QuePaxa 原始論文（由 Cloudflare 文章連結）；WebFetch 回 403，未讀取，文中未引用其內容。
perspective.reader_use: 未讀取，僅作為延伸閱讀線索。

notes.quote: an experimental distributed consensus service designed to manage our internal global control plane.
notes.interpretation: Meerkat 是實驗性服務，管理 Cloudflare 內部全球 control plane。

notes.quote: Unlike similar systems, however, Meerkat was designed for global scale.
notes.interpretation: 全球規模是 Meerkat 與同類系統的差異。

notes.quote: These algorithms rely on a single leader process being available and having predictable latency.
notes.interpretation: 傳統演算法的共同前提是單一 leader 可用且延遲可預測。

notes.quote: If the leader goes down, experiences higher latency than usual, or is disconnected, the entire consensus system slows down or becomes unavailable until the leader is replaced.
notes.interpretation: leader 失效的代價是整個系統變慢或不可用，直到換掉 leader。

notes.quote: most consensus systems use well-established consensus algorithms like Raft, (Multi-)Paxos or Viewstamped Replication.
notes.interpretation: 多數共識系統用的是這三個演算法。

notes.quote: These algorithms are well understood, have mature implementations, and usually work well.
notes.interpretation: Cloudflare 承認這些演算法的優點：被充分理解、實作成熟、通常運作良好。

notes.quote: in 2020, the partial failure of a core Cloudflare network switch caused a consensus-powered system to degrade
notes.interpretation: 2020 年核心交換器局部故障導致依賴共識的系統退化。

notes.quote: the dashboard to operate 80x slower than usual, for six hours.
notes.interpretation: dashboard 比平常慢 80 倍、持續六小時。

notes.quote: Critically, the system lost no data.
notes.interpretation: 沒有掉資料。

notes.quote: But it became unavailable for writes until the issue was resolved, which is unacceptable.
notes.interpretation: 問題解決前寫入不可用，Cloudflare 稱之為 unacceptable。

notes.quote: many of them become disproportionately unavailable or slow when network conditions degrade
notes.interpretation: 許多共識系統在網路狀況惡化時不成比例地不可用或緩慢。

notes.quote: Two proposers can repeatedly block each other from progressing – effectively competing for acceptance.
notes.interpretation: Paxos 中兩個 proposer 可能反覆互相封鎖。

notes.quote: Specifically, another proposer can interleave its own higher ballot number in between the two phases
notes.interpretation: 另一個 proposer 把更高的 ballot number 插進兩個階段之間。

notes.quote: When proposers compete and block each other in this way, we say that they destructively interfere.
notes.interpretation: 此現象名為 destructive interference。

notes.quote: Destructive interference gets worse as more proposers propose their own ballots.
notes.interpretation: proposer 越多越糟。

notes.quote: They both need three votes, but they each have only acquired two votes (their own and another replica's).
notes.interpretation: Raft 分票例子：兩個候選人都需三票、各只有兩票。

notes.quote: The more elections fail, the more replicas will try to get themselves elected leader.
notes.interpretation: 選舉失敗越多，參選的 replica 越多（自我強化）。

notes.quote: Even if the leader stops being faulty, elections continue to disrupt what could have been normal system functioning.
notes.interpretation: 即使 leader 已恢復，選舉仍持續干擾。

notes.quote: Fault detectors react to failures by observing messages on the network, and so their response time has to scale with network latency
notes.interpretation: 故障偵測器的反應時間必須隨網路延遲放大。

notes.quote: Raft is commonly deployed with an election timeout of five to ten times the network round-trip time.
notes.interpretation: Raft 常見 election timeout 為 RTT 的五到十倍。

notes.quote: In QuePaxa, much like in Paxos, there are two roles: proposers and recorders.
notes.interpretation: 兩種角色 proposer 與 recorder。

notes.quote: recorders serve as intermediaries between proposers, recording every proposal they see.
notes.interpretation: recorder 是 proposer 之間的中介並記錄每個看過的提案。

notes.quote: The recorders keep track of the highest-priority proposal they observe.
notes.interpretation: recorder 追蹤看過的最高優先權提案。

notes.quote: The leader is the only proposer capable of deciding in a single round trip.
notes.interpretation: leader 是唯一能單一 round trip 決定的 proposer。

notes.quote: The leader is completely optional.
notes.interpretation: leader 完全可選。

notes.quote: Clients aren't forced to make requests to the leader
notes.interpretation: client 不必只對 leader 發請求，任何 proposer 都能提案（原文後接任何 proposer 可提案之句）。

notes.quote: clients sending proposals to the system hedge their bets: they send their requests for proposals to every replica
notes.interpretation: client hedge：把請求送給每個 replica。

notes.quote: If the QuePaxa leader goes down, we can recover as fast as we want
notes.interpretation: leader 失效時恢復速度不受網路延遲綁住（原文後接 not bound by network latency）。

notes.quote: This hedging timeout is very different from the timeouts used in Raft or Multi-Paxos.
notes.interpretation: hedging 超時與 Raft、Multi-Paxos 的超時不同。

notes.quote: it is locally determined by replicas and can be as small as they want it to be.
notes.interpretation: hedging 超時由 replica 本地決定，可任意小；前一句說它不是 fault detection、不受網路延遲限制。

notes.quote: Instead of having proposers compete to get their own proposals decided
notes.interpretation: QuePaxa 讓 proposer 合作而非競爭。

notes.quote: When proposers receive a proposal from a recorder with a higher priority than theirs,
notes.interpretation: 收到較高優先權提案時改採用之。

notes.quote: This means proposers can’t lock each other out of deciding on a proposal, indefinitely.
notes.interpretation: proposer 無法無限期互鎖。

notes.quote: The leader’s proposal is not randomized, and will always have the highest possible priority.
notes.interpretation: leader 提案不隨機，固定最高優先權。

notes.quote: Yet, given enough rounds, it is guaranteed that proposers agree on a proposal.
notes.interpretation: 給足夠多輪，proposer 保證達成一致。

notes.quote: Proposers randomly select a priority, send their proposals to recorders, and adopt the highest-priority proposal
notes.interpretation: Phase 0 Propose and Adopt。

notes.quote: Proposers spread their adopted proposal to a majority of recorders.
notes.interpretation: Phase 1 Spread。

notes.quote: Proposers ask a majority of recorders for the highest-priority proposal seen in the previous phase.
notes.interpretation: Phase 2 Check and Decide。

notes.quote: Proposers spread their proposals again and adopt the best they find among a majority of recorders.
notes.interpretation: Phase 3 Carry Forward。

notes.quote: After the fourth phase, proposers move on to the next round.
notes.interpretation: 第四階段後進入下一輪。

notes.quote: any two majorities of recorders always share at least one recorder.
notes.interpretation: 任兩個 recorder 多數至少共享一個 recorder。

notes.quote: any other proposer querying a majority will inevitably encounter the leader’s proposal and adopt it
notes.interpretation: 其他 proposer 詢問多數時必然碰到 leader 的提案並採用。

notes.quote: It is impossible to decide on any other proposal.
notes.interpretation: 因此不可能決定其他提案。

notes.quote: Most decisions — upwards of 95% — are made by the leader in the first phase, which keeps our throughput fairly stable.
notes.interpretation: 超過 95% 的決定由 leader 在第一階段完成，吞吐量相當穩定。

notes.quote: At no point have we ever seen it completely stall.
notes.interpretation: 從沒看過完全停擺。

notes.quote: The system slows down, but does not grind to a halt.
notes.interpretation: leader 失效時變慢但不停。

notes.quote: where we had servers spanning nearly all continents
notes.interpretation: 測試叢集伺服器橫跨幾乎所有大陸。

notes.quote: It has not been battle-tested as extensively as Raft or Paxos
notes.interpretation: QuePaxa 實戰驗證不如 Raft、Paxos 廣泛。

notes.quote: This demands careful engineering and stronger evidence of correctness than usual systems.
notes.interpretation: 需要謹慎的工程與比一般系統更強的正確性證據。

notes.quote: That is why we are formally verifying our QuePaxa implementation and Meerkat as a whole,
notes.interpretation: 正在形式化驗證 QuePaxa 實作與整個 Meerkat（進行中）。

notes.quote: we're also extending the original crash-stop design to support crash recovery.
notes.interpretation: 把原始 crash-stop 設計擴充為支援 crash recovery（進行中）。

notes.quote: Meerkat’s global deployment environment led us to a newer consensus algorithm, QuePaxa, which promises better stability despite volatility
notes.interpretation: 全球部署環境把 Cloudflare 帶向 QuePaxa，承諾在波動下更穩定。

notes.quote: in large part by not relying on a leader to make progress.
notes.interpretation: 穩定性很大程度來自不依賴 leader 前進。

notes.quote: Future posts in this series will explain how we verify Meerkat and QuePaxa’s Rust implementation
notes.interpretation: 後續文章會談驗證方式。

notes.quote: what we have learned while turning an academic protocol into a production system.
notes.interpretation: 後續文章也會談把學術協定變成 production 系統所學到的事。

notes.quote: the non-leader replicas will wait for a small timeout, so the leader can propose and decide on its own.
notes.interpretation: 非 leader replica 先等小超時，讓 leader 自行提案決定。

notes.quote: deviate from the paper and have clients wait the hedge timeout instead of the replicas.
notes.interpretation: 實作偏離論文：由 client 等 hedge 超時而非 replica。

notes.quote: we incur extra bandwidth costs and may take more time to decide.
notes.interpretation: hedging 的代價：額外頻寬與可能更慢決定。

notes.quote: hedging isn't free: the more proposers there are, the more proposals get broadcast.
notes.interpretation: proposer 越多，廣播的提案越多。

notes.quote: That's a tradeoff we're more than willing to make.
notes.interpretation: Cloudflare 非常願意接受此取捨。

notes.quote: The decision rate decreases to around 65% of its original rate.
notes.interpretation: leader 故障時決定速率降到約 65%。

notes.quote: returns to 100% when the faulty leader is replaced, a minute after failing.
notes.interpretation: 故障 leader 在失效一分鐘後被換掉，速率回到 100%。

notes.quote: the throughput drops momentarily, down to at most a third of the usual rate.
notes.interpretation: 吞吐量短暫下降，最多掉到平常的三分之一。

notes.quote: Meerkat continuously processes requests, even when the leader crashes, disconnects, or just becomes slow.
notes.interpretation: leader 當機、斷線或變慢時仍持續處理請求。

notes.quote: The QuePaxa paper predicts that each round has a 50% chance of deciding,
notes.interpretation: 論文預測每輪 50% 機率決定。

notes.quote: that probability is much higher, thanks to convergence.
notes.interpretation: Cloudflare 說實際機率高得多，因為收斂。

notes.quote: a failed round doesn't throw away the work already done.
notes.interpretation: 失敗的一輪不丟掉已做的工作。

notes.quote: any algorithm relying on a strict leader or accurate timeouts was inevitably going to stall.
notes.interpretation: 依賴嚴格 leader 或精確超時的演算法終究會停擺。

notes.quote: gracefully degrades performance during latency spikes, connectivity issues, and server failures.
notes.interpretation: QuePaxa 在延遲突波、連線問題、伺服器故障時平緩降級；另可在有利條件下單一 round trip 達成共識。

notes.quote: it might not be possible to spread proposals around well enough to agree on a proposal.
notes.interpretation: 原文警語：提案可能散播不夠好而無法達成一致。

notes.quote: extensive simulation and fault-injection testing
notes.interpretation: Cloudflare 預告的大量模擬與 fault-injection 測試。

claims.evidence: That is why we are formally verifying our QuePaxa implementation and Meerkat as a whole, / we're also extending the original crash-stop design to support crash recovery.
claims.note: Present-progressive in source supports 'in progress'. Also covers Cloudflare 預告 simulation and fault-injection testing (n71, source phrase confirmed). Follow-on sentence about Meerkat remaining experimental is marked as author inference.

claims.claim_text: Meerkat 是一個實驗性的分散式共識服務，用來管理 Cloudflare 內部的全球 control plane，而且和同類系統不同，它從設計之初就瞄準全球規模；Meerkat 底下跑的共識演算法是 QuePaxa
claims.location: opening paragraph
claims.evidence: an experimental distributed consensus service designed to manage our internal global control plane. / Unlike similar systems, however, Meerkat was designed for global scale.
claims.note: Volatile status ('experimental'); source dated 2026-11-11 so fresh. The post's 'Why QuePaxa is the right fit' section attribution is correct; the 'not relying on a leader' phrase is from the introduction, a trivial placement detail.

claims.claim_text: Paxos 一族：其中一個 proposer 可以把自己更高的 ballot number 插進另一個 proposer 的兩個階段之間，兩個 proposer 可能反覆封鎖對方，稱為 destructive interference，proposer 越多越糟
claims.location: under H2「單一 leader 的代價與三種卡住方式」
claims.evidence: Two proposers can repeatedly block each other from progressing – effectively competing for acceptance. ... When proposers compete and block each other in this way, we say that they destructively interfere. Destructive interference gets worse as more proposers propose their own ballots.

claims.claim_text: Raft：兩個候選人都需要三票，卻各自只拿到兩票；選舉失敗得越多，想當選的 replica 越多；即使 leader 已恢復，選舉仍持續干擾
claims.location: under H2「單一 leader 的代價與三種卡住方式」
claims.evidence: They both need three votes, but they each have only acquired two votes (their own and another replica's). The more elections fail, the more replicas will try to get themselves elected leader.
claims.note: The 3-vote/2-vote example is the source's own, not an illustrative number of the post.

claims.claim_text: 合理的推測是，節點分得越開、鏈路的延遲與波動越大，單一 leader 出狀況的機會就越多。這是我的推論
claims.location: under H2「單一 leader 的代價與三種卡住方式」
claims.note: Explicitly marked as inference in the post ('合理的推測是…這是我的推論'). Same for the inference sentences under the hedging-timeout section (hedging need not decide if leader is broken; timeout tuning trades latency vs bandwidth) and the Meerkat-stays-experimental inference; all are marked.
